[EN] Your reward tier is too low.
[ES] Tu nivel de recompensa es demasiado bajo.

[EN] Welcome, !

In appreciation of all you have done, I have been authorized to present you with treasures gathered from all over the world.

But you must prove your worth before you can claim them.

Let me know when you are ready."I'm ready."Claim Treasure
[ES] ¡Bienvenido, !

En agradecimiento por todo lo que has hecho, se me ha autorizado a entregarte tesoros reunidos de todo el mundo.

Pero debes demostrar tu valía antes de poder reclamarlos.

Avísame cuando estés listo."I'm ready."Claim Treasure
